versions.changelog:
work-productivity-pollyreach-gives-workflow-helper v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Provides validated, checklist-driven workflow assistance for users requesting PollyReach-style productivity help.
- Generates concise work plans, templates, and artifacts to address practical bug fixes, reliability, safety improvements, or adjacent skills.
- Supports local-friendly implementation (scripts, templates, checklists) over cloud- or resource-intensive solutions.
- Lists triggers, validation rules, and expected outputs for repeatable coverage of similar requests.
